The convergence function is `Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It performs the actual HTTP request. `PostAsync` enqueues tasks to a channel consumed by worker goroutines. Those workers invoke `Post`, which then calls `safeClient.Do(req)` to deliver the outbound request.

The RPC handlers are implemented in `APIV1Service` across the `memo_service*.go` files. Three methods can transitively trigger outbound HTTP to user-configured URLs:

`SetMemoAttachments` in `memo_attachment_service.go` and `SetMemoRelations` in `memo_relation_service.go` both route through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`.

assistantMessage.text:
## RPC Handlers That Trigger Outbound HTTP to User-Configured URLs

In this Memos repo, user-configured URLs are **webhooks** stored per user (`store.GetUserWebhooks`). Several memo-related RPC handlers can transitively POST to those URLs. At least these six do:

| RPC Handler | File |
|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `DeleteMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` |

These are also exposed via Connect/gRPC wrappers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (e.g. `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` delegates to `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`).

Webhook CRUD handlers (`CreateUserWebhook`, `UpdateUserWebhook`, etc. in `user_service_webhooks.go`) only **store** the URL; they do not send HTTP.

---

## Convergence Function

**`Post`** in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

All webhook delivery paths converge here before the actual HTTP request is sent via `safeClient.Do(req)`.

---

## Call Chain

```
RPC Handler (e.g. CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo)
    │
    ▼
Dispatch*Webhook helpers (memo_service_webhooks.go)
  • DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook      → activity "memos.memo.created"
  • DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook      → activity "memos.memo.updated"
  • DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook      → activity "memos.memo.deleted"
  • DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook → activity "memos.memo.comment.created"
    │
    ▼
Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, userID)   // loads user-configured hook.Url values
    │
    ▼
Build WebhookRequestPayload { URL, ActivityType, Memo, SigningSecret, ... }
    │
    ▼
webhook.PostAsync(payload)           // internal/webhook/webhook.go
    │
    ▼
asyncPostQueue (128-slot channel, 4 worker goroutines from init())
    │
    ▼
webhook.Post(payload)                ← CONVERGENCE: single HTTP delivery point
    │
    ▼
safeClient.Do(req)  →  POST to payload.URL
```

### Handler-specific paths

1. **`CreateMemo`** — after persisting the memo, calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` directly.

2. **`UpdateMemo`**, **`SetMemoAttachments`**, **`SetMemoRelations`** — call `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_update_helpers.go`), which calls `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`.

3. **`DeleteMemo`** — converts the memo, then calls `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` before deletion.

4. **`CreateMemoComment`** — internally calls `CreateMemo` (triggering `memos.memo.created` for the comment author’s webhooks), then calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` for the **parent memo owner’s** webhooks.

### Shared dispatch logic

`dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` and `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` both:
- load registered webhooks for the target user
- set `payload.URL = hook.Url`
- call `webhook.PostAsync(payload)`

`PostAsync` only enqueues; four background workers drain the queue and call **`Post`**, which marshals JSON, optionally signs with HMAC (Standard Webhooks), and performs the outbound POST through an SSRF-hardened `http.Client` (`safeDialContext` blocks private/reserved IPs unless `allow-private-webhooks` is enabled).

**Handlers (≥3):** `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `CreateMemoComment`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations` — all on `APIV1Service` under `server/router/api/v1/`.

**Convergence function:** `Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go`

These RPC handlers can transitively POST to user-configured webhook URLs (`hook.Url` from `Store.GetUserWebhooks`). The webhook CRUD handlers in `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go` only store URLs; they do not send HTTP.

| Handler | File | Webhook dispatch path |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` |
| `DeleteMemo` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` | calls `CreateMemo` (created webhook) + `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` → `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` |

Shared dispatch logic lives in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`: `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` and `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` load webhooks, set `payload.URL = hook.Url`, and call `webhook.PostAsync`. Workers in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` drain the queue and all call `Post`, which performs the outbound request via `safeClient.Do(req)` at line 152. That is the single convergence point before HTTP delivery.
